role: Quality and Infrastructure, Co-op SmartVu Developer
jd:
Survalent is looking for an innovative and enthusiastic COOP Quality and Infrastructure Developer to join our SmartVu Development team for an eight-month/one year work term starting in January 2027. In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of secure, reliable, and high-performance Windows desktop applications that help electric utilities monitor, control, and manage power flow for the safe and efficient delivery of electricity. If you are passionate about quality practices and real-time software applications, this is a great opportunity for you!


Responsibilities & Essential Functions:
•Work with the Team Lead and senior developers to design, develop, test, and maintain C#/.NET Windows desktop applications.
•Build and enhance desktop user interfaces using technologies such as WPF, XAML, and established UI design patterns.
•Develop application logic, reusable components, and integrations with server-side services, databases, and real-time systems.
•Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code using object-oriented principles and software design patterns.
•Create and maintain unit, integration, and automated functional tests, and assist with diagnosing and resolving software defects.
•Collaborate with build and quality teams to support continuous integration, automated builds, and software release processes.
•Create technical documentation and participate in code reviews, design discussions, and Agile development activities.
•Other duties as required.


Education, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
•Currently enrolled in a university program in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
•Experience and/or familiarity with C# and the .NET platform.
•Experience developing Windows desktop applications using WPF, XAML, or a comparable desktop UI framework.
•Solid understanding of object-oriented programming principles, data structures, and software design patterns.
•Familiarity with desktop application patterns such as MVVM and with creating intuitive, accessible user interfaces.
•Experience using Visual Studio and debugging, profiling, and diagnostic tools.
•Familiarity with unit testing frameworks and automated software testing practices.
•Experience with relational databases and SQL; familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server is an asset.
•Experience with source control and collaborative development workflows using Git, Bitbucket, or similar tools.
•Familiarity with APIs, networking concepts, or application integration is an asset.
•Ability to learn new technologies, communicate clearly, and work effectively in a collaborative Agile team.


This is an 8-month/one-year co-op position reporting to the Team Lead, SmartVu. The hourly range for this role is $20. If you are interested in this exciting role, please apply with a resume and cover letter by selecting the following link: https://www.fitzii.com/apply/101120?s=li


About Us:
Survalent Technology Corporation is the leading provider of real-time smart grid management systems for enabling visualization, optimization and improved operations for utilities. For six decades, we have helped more than 800 utilities use operational data to increase reliability, efficiency, and customer service. With our proven and reliable SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), Distribution Management System (DMS), Outage Management System (OMS), and Substation Automation (SA) solutions, utilities transform data into actionable intelligence. We partner with utilities across the globe to create mission critical solutions that will achieve the promise of the Smart Grid.


Survalent values a diverse workplace and strongly encourages women, people of all races, color, creed, ancestry, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, marital status, family status, and those with disabilities to apply. We use AI tools to help streamline parts of our recruitment process, but every application is reviewed by a member of our team. Survalent is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing accommodations for persons with disabilities. If you require accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs.


While we appreciate the interest of all applicants, only those selected for an interview will be contacted

Please Note: 

 To provide the best candidate experience amidst our high application volumes, each candidate is limited to 10 applications across all open jobs within a 6-month period. 

 Advancing the World’s Technology Together 

 Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day--including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. Here, you’ll have an opportunity to be part of a global leader whose innovative designs are pushing the boundaries of what’s possible and powering the future. 

 We believe innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We’re dedicated to empowering people to be their true selves. Together, we’re building a better tomorrow for our employees, customers, partners, and communities.

 What You’ll Do 

 The SoC Architect team proposes multiple SoC level architecture candidates for emerging memory/storage solution and demonstrates that the proposed architecture is viable through hands-on RTL implementation. 

 This role offers the opportunity to shape next-generation SoC and subsystem architectures while staying deeply hands-on in RTL design, FPGA integration, and validation. It is ideal for engineers who want to turn advanced memory and storage concepts into real hardware and drive them all the way to silicon. 

 Location: Daily onsite presence at our San Jose, CA headquarters in alignment with our Flexible Work policy 

 Reports to:  Senior Director 

• Deploy and operate an LLM inference service (vLLM serving Llama-3.3-70B) on a 4 × NVIDIA H200 GPU server, working closely with your mentor and the storage architecture team. 

• Build an automated benchmark harness that replays long-context, multi-turn and agent-style request traces and records latency and throughput (TTFT, TPOT, goodput). 

• Configure KV cache offloading (LMCache, NVIDIA Dynamo/NIXL) to network-attached storage over NVMe-oF and RDMA, first on a BlueField-3 storage server and then on our network-attached SSD prototype. 

• Run daily experiment sweeps across request rates, context lengths and cache sizes, keeping every configuration and result reproducible in git. 

• Analyze results with Python to find bottlenecks across the GPU, network and SSD, and share findings in weekly team meetings. 

• Collaborate with FPGA, SoC and firmware engineers to debug the end-to-end data path and validate KV cache correctness. 

• Summarize the measured storage requirements (bandwidth, IOPS, latency) that shape the architecture of future SSD controllers, and present them to the team at the end of the internship.

• Complete other responsibilities as assigned. 
 
 What You Bring 

• Pursuing Bachelors, Masters, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field preferred. 

• Must have at least 1 academic quarter/semester remaining. 

• Hands-on experience running LLM inference with Python and PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs under Linux, using a serving framework such as vLLM, SGLang or Hugging Face TGI. 

• Understanding of LLM serving internals: KV cache, prefix caching, batching and parallelism (tensor/pipeline), and latency metrics such as TTFT, TPOT and throughput. 

• Experience benchmarking and profiling system performance, and analyzing results with scripts (e.g., Python, pandas, plotting) to explain bottlenecks. 

• Familiarity with KV cache offloading (LMCache, NVIDIA Dynamo/NIXL), RDMA/RoCE or NVMe/NVMe-oF storage, and containers (Docker/Kubernetes) preferred. 

• You’re inclusive, adapting your style to the situation and diverse global norms of our people. 

• An avid learner, you approach challenges with curiosity and resilience, seeking data to help build understanding. 

• You’re collaborative, building relationships, humbly offering support and openly welcoming approaches. 

• Innovative and creative, you proactively explore new ideas and adapt quickly to change.
